coverage_limits: This download contains compiled native libraries and helpers without a complete bundled machine-readable SBOM or all native dependency copyright/license notices. The named notices are retained but are not a completeness attestation.

The release source tag and macOS recipe commit are pinned, including source archive hashes and build patches. The recipe is not by itself a verified, archived corresponding-source closure for every linked library, Ghostscript/font/CMap data and the customized Python framework.

MacOS recipe dynamically installs prebuilt Python framework from python_macos/v21.3 and NumPy universal2 wheel; their corresponding source/build parameters need separate preservation before Mirket rehosts these binary contents.

External upstream source URLs are not an availability guarantee. If Mirket conveys binary copies, GPLv3 section6(d) requires equivalent no-charge corresponding-source access and clear directions adjacent to the binary, while the distributor remains responsible for availability.
GPL-3.0-or-later is the Inkscape binary license; Ghostscript is a separate AGPL-3.0-or-later component, plus its own documented font/CMap exceptions. Other libraries retain their own licenses.
